risks.title: Dependency on Advanced Semiconductor Customer Demand
risks.score_rationale: Major risk at the core of ASML's business model. Intense language on customer concentration (EUV/Logic/DRAM) and sector cyclicality volatility. Trend stable but structural. High categorical weight: EUR 32.7 Bn in sales depend on 3-4 major customers.

risks.title: Export Controls and Geopolitical Restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements (export control policy and regulations). Tense geopolitical context (China, US sanctions). High uncertainty language. Trend increasing: growing impact on commercial strategy and R&D.

risks.title: R&D Intensity and Technology Risk in EUV/High-NA
risks.score_rationale: R&D spending of EUR 4.7 Bn (14% of sales) concentrated on EUV 0.55 NA and EXE 5200B. Uncertainty language on qualification and volume adoption. Trend stable but high risk of technology delays. Major categorical weight for competitive differentiation.

risks.title: Complex Supply Chain and Critical Supplier Dependencies
risks.score_rationale: 5,100 global suppliers mentioned. Moderate language but fragile post-COVID supply chain context. Trend stable but structural vulnerability. High categorical weight: delivery times and quality critical for EUR 38.8 Bn backlog.

risks.title: Intellectual Property and Counterfeiting/Technology Imitation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Highly sensitive proprietary technology (EUV, multibeam, High-NA). Implicit language on IP protection. Trend stable but rising risk with technology diffusion. Major categorical weight: competitive advantage rests on IP.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Protection of Sensitive Customer Data
risks.score_rationale: Information security section mentioned. Moderate language but tense geopolitical context increases risk. Trend increasing: privileged targets for cyberattacks. High categorical weight: critical customer data and sensitive IP.

risks.title: EUV System Energy Consumption and Sustainability
risks.score_rationale: Intensive CEO language on long-term energy challenge (57% reduction since 2018, target 30-40% additional). Risk of increasing carbon regulation. Trend increasing: AI data centers amplify energy pressure. Growing categorical weight.

risks.title: Geographic Concentration and Localization Risks (Netherlands)
risks.score_rationale: Main campus at Veldhoven (Netherlands) mentioned. Moderate language on local challenges (affordable housing). Trend stable but structural vulnerability. Moderate categorical weight: impact on costs and talent.
